questions.question: Define the internal quantum efficiency of an LED.
questions.solution_html:
• Compare the internal and external quantum efficiency of an
  • LED
  • Ans Internal quantum efficiency is the ratio of the number of
  • photons generated inside the LED to the number of
  • electron–hole recombinations, indicating how efficiently
  • carriers produce light. External quantum efficiency is the
  • ratio of the number of photons emitted from the LED to the
  • number of injected electrons, and it is lower due to optical
  • losses such as reflection and absorption within the device.
  • Hence, internal efficiency relates to generation, while
  • external efficiency includes both generation and extraction
  • of light.
